_comment: Build-time overrides for scripts/gtfs-shapes.mjs (npm run build:network). JSON carries no comments, so this key holds the file's purpose, the way scripts/zet-schema-overrides.json's allowlists carry a reason per entry. unreachableStops: platforms a shapeless tram pattern calls at that lie further than SERVED_STOP_MAX_METRES (60 m) from every rail edge the feed's shapes draw, and that are not a first or last stop the TERMINUS_STOP_MAX_METRES (200 m) override already reaches. Without an entry here such a stop FAILS the build by name, because an interior stop off the rails is normally a wrong coordinate or a missing shape, not something to route past silently. An entry says the stop is genuinely off the graph and the synthetic path should be routed past it: the path will neither run to it nor serve it. Each entry is { id, name, reason } -- the id is what matches, the name is for the reader. On feed 000395 the list is empty: every stop of every shapeless tram pattern is within 60 m of a rail once the router reads the served radius (F8b). longLegs: hops of a synthetic path whose routed arc still runs past HOP_DETOUR_FACTOR (2x) the straight line AND HOP_DETOUR_EXCESS_METRES (500 m) longer after F8c has noded every crossing the reported legs could turn at. Without an entry the build FAILS, because a detour that long is a missing junction, not a route. An entry is { from, to, reason } and matches on the two platforms' names (add route to narrow it to one line); the reason must say why the graph cannot express the turn.

longLegs.reason: The west-to-north turn at Glavni kolodvor is drawn by no shape in feed 000395, and unlike the other eight reported legs it cannot be noded: the eastbound Mihanovićeva track ENDS at the junction (its node takes only the eastward continuation) and the northbound Trg kralja Tomislava track STARTS 6.79 m away (its node is fed only from the east), so the two polylines never cross and no split point lies on both -- 6.79 m is far past SNAP_METRES (2.5 m), and merging the two nodes instead would grow three U-turns no tram makes. Routes 6 and 9 therefore keep a 3,242 m plan for 511 m of ground on this hop until a shape draws the turn. Their westbound counterpart (Zrinjevac -> Botanički vrt, routes 6 and 17) IS noded: there the southbound track overshoots and really does cross the westbound one.
